prompts.text: Which film would divide this group most if we tried to rank it?
We have ten minutes to agree on a movie, but everyone wants a different genre. What's the fairest method?
A comedy everyone has seen or a mystery nobody knows anything about?
Tell us about a movie you watched with friends that was funnier because of their reactions.
A film night needs good snacks more than a perfectly chosen film.
Some movies become group favourites because of the jokes people make while watching.
Who here is most likely to predict a film's ending halfway through?
We must create a movie poster starring everyone in this room. What's the title?
Pause to debate every plot twist or save all opinions until the credits roll?
Which fictional villain would struggle most to survive a group chat with us?
Who in this group is most likely to finish a whole series in one weekend?
Tell us about a show you recommended so strongly your friends finally gave in.
We are contestants on a fictional game show. What challenge would expose our different personalities?
One episode every week or a whole season available at once?
A satisfying series finale matters more than the first episode being spectacular.
People often remember who introduced them to a series as clearly as the story itself.
Which television character would become the most entertaining member of our group?
Everyone must pitch a spin-off for a side character from a familiar show. Who goes first?
Watch a short sitcom together or debate a complicated drama?
What's the most surprising show you've ever enjoyed despite expecting to dislike it?
What kind of comedy makes nearly everyone in this group laugh?
Tell us about a stand-up joke whose timing was funnier than the words.
We have to put together a five-minute comedy sketch using only objects on this table. What's the premise?
A comedian with sharp observations or one who tells ridiculous stories?
The funniest group memories often begin with a completely ordinary mistake.
Different people sometimes laugh at different parts of the same joke.
Who here has the best talent for telling a story with dramatic sound effects?
We're making a silent comedy scene about getting ready for a party. Who plays which role?
An improv comedy show or a classic comedy film?
What harmless running joke would make a good title for our group's comedy special?
Which board game would reveal everyone's competitive side fastest?
Our game night needs a new rule to stop one person winning every round. What do we invent?
A cooperative puzzle or a fast-paced trivia contest?
Tell us about a game night where a surprising player became the champion.
A good party game makes the losing team laugh as much as the winners.
People who seem quiet at dinner sometimes become the loudest players in a guessing game.
Who in this group would make the most convincing game-show host?
We must design a party game using only paper, pens and a timer. What's the objective?
Charades with impossible clues or drawing games with terrible artists?
What game would you bring to entertain a group where nobody knows one another?
What hidden talent would surprise the rest of us most if you performed it tonight?
Tell us about a performance where somebody unexpectedly stole the show.
Our group enters a talent show and must perform one act together. What should we attempt?
A group dance routine or a comedy song with original lyrics?
Confidence makes an ordinary talent-show act more entertaining than expensive props.
The best audience reactions often come when a performer takes a playful risk.
Who here would volunteer to perform first without any rehearsal?
We have to assign everyone a stage name for one night. What's our naming rule?
A magic trick with audience volunteers or a dramatic storytelling performance?
What's a talent you admire because it looks much easier than it is?
Which animated film would be funniest if all of us voiced its characters?
Our group gets to invent a new cartoon sidekick. What unusual ability should it have?
A clever animated adventure or a comedy full of visual jokes?
Tell us about an animated character you liked more than the main hero.
Animation is often at its best when it takes a completely silly idea seriously.
An animated character's smallest facial expression can be the funniest moment in a scene.
Which animated setting would make the best location for our next group outing?
We're writing the opening scene of a cartoon about this group. What goes wrong first?
Rewatch a childhood animated favourite or try a new animated film together?
What's an animated scene whose humour works even without dialogue?
What kind of live show would make this group most enthusiastic to go out together?
Tell us about a live performance where the audience became part of the entertainment.
We get free tickets to one event tonight, but the organiser won't tell us the act. Who's coming?
An outdoor comedy festival or a small theatre production?
A memorable live show doesn't need a famous performer if the audience feels involved.
The same performance can feel different depending on the crowd watching it.
Who here is most likely to end up participating in a stage show unexpectedly?
Our group must choose a seat at a theatre with an unusual stage layout. What matters most?
A spontaneous open-mic evening or a carefully rehearsed musical production?
What's one live entertainment experience you'd like everyone to try at least once?
If our group appeared in a mystery film, who would spot the first clue?
We're a team in a heist comedy, but the only thing we're stealing is a giant birthday cake. What's the plan?
Play characters in a fantasy adventure or become detectives in a cosy mystery?
Tell us about a film where a group of unlikely characters worked surprisingly well together.
The funniest fictional teams have members with completely different approaches to simple problems.
A good ensemble story gives every character a chance to contribute something unexpected.
Which fictional world would test our group's patience the most?
We're given a talking vehicle as the main character in our film. What personality should it have?
A superhero team with useless powers or a space crew with terrible navigation?
What fictional character would become our group's unofficial organiser?
What kind of podcast episode would keep this entire group interested for an hour?
Tell us about an audio story whose ending made you want to discuss it with someone.
We launch a group podcast tomorrow. What's our first episode about?
A funny interview with a guest or a group discussion of an unusual mystery?
A good podcast host knows when to let an interesting guest finish a story.
Audio storytelling leaves plenty of room for listeners to picture the scene differently.
Who here would be best at introducing guests without reading from a script?
Our podcast needs a fifteen-second opening sound. What should listeners hear?
Listen to an investigative audio series or a collection of short funny stories?
What's a subject you'd listen to a podcast about even if you knew almost nothing about it?
Which entertainment category would you choose as your specialist subject in a quiz?
We have to write a trivia round about our shared memories. What's the first question?
Guess films from one line of dialogue or identify shows from their opening music?
Tell us about confidently giving the wrong answer to a pop-culture question.
A fun trivia night needs surprising questions more than obscure facts.
People often remember a film's poster while forgetting its title.
Who here has the most unexpectedly detailed knowledge of a television show?
We create a quiz where the answers are all members of this group. What clue would make everyone laugh?
A picture round with familiar characters or an audio round with sound effects?
What's one entertainment fact you know that nobody ever asks about?
